title: WorkloadStatus
description: A knowledge base's operational readings from Collector metrics. Ledger occupancy and queue depth are current gauges; completed and failed are worker counters since that worker process started. Missing readings are unknown, never zero.

ledger.description: Live claims held in the Gateway's correlation ledger and its configured capacity.

capacity.description: The Gateway's reported maximum number of live claims.

queue.description: Current Dispatcher depth and, when the worker has emitted counters, completed and failed work since worker start. These are different measurements and time windows.

pending.description: Jobs currently waiting for a worker.

failed.description: Jobs finally failed since worker start.
